subject: [PATCH v3 04/12] mm/collapse: add collapse.h for the collapse interface

2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch adds a new header file, mm/collapse.h, to separate the interface and state of the collapse mechanism from its implementation in khugepaged.c. The new header defines an enum for scan results and a struct for control data passed between the user and engine sides. Two constants are also moved from khugepaged.c to the new header. This change improves code organization and maintainability without introducing any functional changes.
